versos.texto_bv: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: “Esta é a fronteira segundo a qual vocês repartirão a terra em herança para as doze tribos de Israel: a José caberão porções.”
versos.traducao_literal: Assim disse o Senhor DEUS: esta [é] a fronteira segundo a qual herdareis a terra, para as doze tribos de Israel; José, porções.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Possível omissão do numeral 'duas' (porções) para José: NTLH/ARA/NVIPT convergem em indicar 'duas partes/porções', ausentes na traducao_literal e no texto_bv. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'José, porções' (sem numeral); NTLH: 'a tribo de José receberá duas partes'; ARA: 'José terá duas partes'; NVIPT: 'com duas porções para José'. Corrigir exigiria acrescentar conteúdo numérico ausente na camada literal pinada — mudança de sentido, fora do escopo de revisão de forma; requer verificação de fidelidade ao hebraico antes de qualquer ajuste no texto_bv.

kjv.texto: Thus saith the Lord God; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.

vizinhos.12: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
vizinhos.14: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

web.texto: Thus says the Lord Yahweh: This shall be the border, by which you shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.

vizinhos.12: By the river on its bank, on this side and on that side, shall grow every tree for food, whose leaf shall not wither, neither shall its fruit fail: it shall produce new fruit every month, because its waters issue out of the sanctuary; and its fruit shall be for food, and its leaf for healing.
vizinhos.14: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers: and this land shall fall to you for inheritance.
